## What and why

Describe the user outcome, changed areas and explicit exclusions.

## Verification

- Base and tested head SHA:
- Commands/scenarios, working directory and results:

## Impact and release

- User-visible and security/privacy impact:
- Deployment impact (including existing automation triggered by a docs-only merge):

## Documentation and handoff

- [ ] Relevant guides match the actual source and command names.
- [ ] Evidence identifies the tested commit and does not expose secrets or personal data.
- [ ] Handoff gives the next step and distinguishes prepared work from released work.

Use `docs/HANDOFF-TEMPLATE.md` when a fuller cross-agent handoff is needed.
